home.title: Cockpit Context
home.description: Let your AI coding agents ask how to use your dependencies. Cockpit Context answers by reading the real source code at the exact version you use.
home.inviteOnly: This server is invite-only. Ask an administrator for an invitation.

fileDrop.ignored: That file can't be dropped here.

offline.band: You're offline. Changes you make won't be saved until you reconnect.
offline.queued: You're offline. This change will be sent when you reconnect. Keep this tab open.
offline.queuedSent: Back online. Your offline change was sent.

keyValue.textHint: One KEY=value per line. Lines starting with # are ignored. You can paste a whole .env file.
keyValue.secretTextHint: Secret values are shown unmasked in this view.

errors.emptyKey: Enter a key for this value
errors.invalidKey: {{key}} is not a valid key. Use letters, digits and underscores, not starting with a digit.
errors.reservedKey: {{key}} is set by the platform and can't be changed here

lineReasons.invalid-key: the key is empty or contains spaces or quotes
lineReasons.unterminated-quote: the quoted value is never closed
lineReasons.trailing-characters: unexpected text after the closing quote
lineReasons.duplicate-key: this key was already defined; the last value wins
